_meta.note: All exclusions are source-level rejections. Individual observation exclusions also recorded in evidence.v0.json.

exclusions.reason: City directory landing page — marketing text only, no price data.
All price-specific URLs returned 404. Platform may require authentication or restructured URLs.
exclusions.reconsideration_note: Retry different URL patterns or contact platform in future research phase.

exclusions.reason: URL returned HTTP 200 but content body was empty (JavaScript-rendered content not accessible via plain fetch).
exclusions.reconsideration_note: Browser-based scraping may access the full page. Low priority — other sources sufficient.

exclusions.reason: Individual artisan classified advertisements. Self-published asking prices subject to negotiation, no editorial standard, represents artisan self-interest rather than market observation. Cannot be treated as market evidence.
exclusions.note: Classified ads structurally incompatible with market price evidence. Even if prices were extracted, they would require significant normalization and remain unreliable.
